kultivator.tempat_perbaikan.inspired: Inspired by villagers rebuilding together after a disaster, the rope-lashed bamboo scaffolding of Chinese and Southeast Asian building sites, and xianxia scenes where townsfolk demand compensation yet tremble before a far stronger cultivator; game design.

kultivator.tempat_perbaikan.layar.sub_ib: Blood Price: in this city everything is paid twice.

Pay: the enforcers forget your face, hired hands work x%s faster.

kultivator.tempat_perbaikan.akibat.donas: Every coin speeds the craftsmen; materials you bring go straight into the walls.
kultivator.tempat_perbaikan.kalimat.bias: “Forgive me, sir... the fence and a few houses were damaged yesterday. We have counted everything honestly.”
“The craftsmen have counted every missing stone and plank. Here is the list, not a coin more.”
“We are small folk, sir. Our grandfathers raised that wall. We ask you to bear the cost.”
“The rule here is simple: who breaks, mends. We trust you are one who knows the rules.”
“Witnesses saw it all. Pay, and the matter ends without a fuss.”
kultivator.tempat_perbaikan.kalimat.ibli: “You broke what belongs to the Overlord. Here debts are paid in stone... or in blood.”
“The Blood Price is set. Do not haggle long; my patience is thin.”
“Every brick of this city was oiled with blood once. Replace it, or add yours.”
kultivator.tempat_perbaikan.kalimat.taku: “P-please forgive us, Senior... we will repair it ourselves. Do not trouble yourself.”
“This humble one dares ask nothing. The broken houses... were old anyway.”
“We only wish Senior to know our craftsmen will work, slowly. May Senior not be angered.”
“We have sent the children indoors. Please... let nothing else fall.”
kultivator.tempat_perbaikan.kalimat.dona: “The damage came from %s. There is no one to bill, so we ask any willing hand.”
“Timber and stone can be bought, hands can be lent. We write every bit of help on the board.”
“After %s, half our craftsmen still nurse their wounds. If you carry materials, bring them here.”
“Many hands, sir. One plank from you, one from us, and the house stands again.”
